title: Occupation
description: Some town residents have to band together after a devastating alien invasion. As they struggle to survive, they realize they must stay one step ahead of their attackers and work together for a chance to strike back.

title: Occupation: Rainfall
description: Two years into an intergalactic invasion of Earth, survivors fight back in a desperate ground war. While casualties mount by the day, the resistance -- along with some unexpected allies -- uncovers a plot that could bring the war to a decisive end.

title: Pandorum
description: Two astronauts (Dennis Quaid, Ben Foster) discover a terrifying reality after awaking disoriented, aboard a seemingly abandoned spaceship.

title: Ender's Game
description: After an alien invasion, an unlikely recruit commands Earth's forces and fights for the future of humanity.

title: The Arrival
description: Astronomer Zane Zaminsky finds extraterrestrials and conspiracy after tracking strange radio signals to a Mexican village.

title: Kin

title: Precious Cargo
description: To get back in the good graces of her murderous boss (Bruce Willis), a seductive thief (Claire Forlani) recruits an ex-lover (Mark-Paul Gosselaar) to steal rare and valuable gems.
